item.title: Belidor: A Language for User Interface Analogies
item.description: A specification language for the structure underlying user interfaces. Beldior can express a wide range of UIs (simple and complex GUIs, screen readers, and hardware devices). Belidor's semantics help surface analogies between very different interfaces (eg. a calendar and a video editor).

item.title: Color Field: Professional Vision for Color Grading
item.description: An interactive tool to visualize the effect of color filters as a vector field over a color space. We draw inspiration from Goodwin's Professional Vision to help novices "see" color grading like experts.
